COMPUTER STUDIES MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Emerging Technologies, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Emerging Technologies.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Emerging Technologies.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emerging Technologies.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Emerging Technologies.

2. When learning Cybersecurity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cybersecurity.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cybersecurity.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cybersecurity.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Cybersecurity.

3. When learning Data Analysis and Visualisation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data Analysis and Visualisation.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Data Analysis and Visualisation.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Analysis and Visualisation.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data Analysis and Visualisation.

4. When learning Robotics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Robotics.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Robotics.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Robotics.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Robotics.

5. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

6. When learning Social and Ethical Issues in Networking, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Social and Ethical Issues in Networking.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Social and Ethical Issues in Networking.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Social and Ethical Issues in Networking.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Social and Ethical Issues in Networking.

7. When learning Career Opportunities, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Opportunities.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Career Opportunities.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Career Opportunities.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Career Opportunities.

8. When learning Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.

9. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Speaker
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

10. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Input Cable Tester

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

12. When learning Network Troubleshooting, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Network Troubleshooting.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Network Troubleshooting.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Network Troubleshooting.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Network Troubleshooting.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Network Troubleshooting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Cybersecurity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Cloud Computing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Social and Ethical Issues in Networking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emerging Technologies.

2. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cybersecurity.

3. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Analysis and Visualisation.

4. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Robotics.

5. D — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

6. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Social and Ethical Issues in Networking.

7. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Opportunities.

8. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.

9. A — CPU

10. C — Information and Communication Technology

11. C — Never touch live wires with wet hands

12. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Network Troubleshooting.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Network Troubleshooting; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Cybersecurity; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Cloud Computing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Social and Ethical Issues in Networking; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
